capabilities: Hide Markdown formatting marks with whitespace visualization, boundary tooltips and caret visibility guards
Enhance list and callout editing with atomic markers, backspace level promotion, soft breaks, folding and in-place callout editing
Open files, wikilinks and bookmarks in new tabs with vertical tab management and cursor/scroll position persistence
Add custom or hidden commands to the left ribbon, status bar and editor context menu
Delay community plugin startup with per-plugin lazy loading and startup timing stats
extras: Pre-release versions are installable via the BRAT plugin; data is stored in .obsidian/ with read-only mirrors in the plugin folder to survive sync-tool deletions. Bilingual English/Chinese interface; author accepts PayPal donations.
problem: Obsidian's editor still shows formatting marks, misplaces clicks after callouts, and offers limited control over list behavior, tab opening, ribbon/status-bar commands and plugin startup timing.

relations.evidence: Combined with custom-mark plugins like Task Collector, the completion state can be rewritten

summary: Editing-experience toolkit that hides Markdown marks, enhances lists and callouts, manages tabs, and adds custom commands to ribbon, status bar and menus.
